warnings: CORRECTED 2026-08-24 — pixel survey. Grid pinned at x 1=1043, 2=1437, 3=1752, 4=2067 px (78.8 px/m) and y E=575, D=890, C=1089, B=1408, A=1604 px, both scales agreeing. ADDED: a whole edge beam line that was missing from the extraction — B1A on dummy column 4' (14.10), which is the '1.10' printed beyond grid 4 on the top margin. It traces as one continuous line at x=2153 px from y=568 to y=1411 (row E to row B) and carries the B1A mark three times, so it is recorded as three atomic segments E-D / D-C / C-B.

⚠️ The E-D band carries NO beam on grid 3: a coverage sweep of that band returns face pairs at x=1035/1051 (grid 1), 1146/1161, 1429/1445 (grid 2), 1665/1681, 1862/1878 and 2059 (grid 4) — nothing brackets grid 3 at 1752, although the D-C and C-B bands both do (1744/1760). Not corrected in the element list because the extraction never claimed a grid-3 beam there; recorded here so a later pass does not 'restore' one.

⚠️ The two interior verticals measured in the E-D band sit at about 8.00 m and 10.50 m east of grid 1 (centres x=1673 and 1870 px, marks read as B3 and B2A). Those positions are NOT dimensioned — the top margin prints only 5.00 / 4.00 / 4.00 with a 1.50 + 3.50 sub-chain inside bay 1-2 — so no dummy columns were created for them and they keep their '~bay' refs, same as house 45's interior beams. Note also that the master's existing x dummy 1'' = 3.35 is not traceable to any printed dimension on this sheet either (the only sub-chain here gives 1.50); it was inherited from the earlier extraction and is left untouched but flagged.

This is the busiest single sheet in the house: an entry vestibule with a stair (ST1, near grid1/E-D), an accessible ramp (SO, below row A between grid1 and grid1'') with 3 short stub beams (B3A) landing on it, and a repeated precast-plank bay pattern (SP/SPA/SP1/SI/S2/SX markers) across all 3 main bays.

PERIMETER CHORDS and EDGE VERTICALS (rows E/D/C/B, grid columns 1/1'/1''/2/3/4, and the ramp stubs at row A-A') are recorded with full grid_ref_start/grid_ref_end precision, cross-checked pixel-by-pixel against the established grid master.

INTERIOR PARTITION/SUPPORT BEAMS (marks B2, B2A, B3, B4, B4A, B4B recurring inside each bay, supporting the SP/SPA precast-plank fields) do NOT have their own printed local dimension chain on this sheet — unlike the footing plan (S-02), no witness-line dimension pins their exact x-position inside a bay. Per §4's beam-endpoint rule these are still recorded (never dropped), but with span_source:'unresolved' and a descriptive bay location instead of an invented grid_ref_start/end. This is a deliberate, flagged simplification for a dense room layout, consistent with op04's pass-2 scope — the alternative (guessing sub-bay positions) would violate the 'never estimate pos_m' rule.
Slab marker 'SI' (letter I) vs 'S1' (digit 1): this sheet uses 'S1' (digit) at the grid3-4 bay per the printed circles — double-checked per §10 since these two are known lookalikes in this dataset.

Row A between grid1''-grid2 shows a hatched 'stair nosing' pocket (พอกขั้นบันได, detailed on S-15) rather than a clear ground beam mark between footings F5@A2 and F5@A3 — recorded as unresolved rather than assuming a beam mark not clearly legible at this scan resolution.
